name: 08031 · Bellmawr, NJ
findings: ZIP 08031 (Bellmawr) has 26 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 7 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 08031 (Bellmawr) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
30% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 08031 (Bellmawr) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 61% of the typical level).
